summary: A closed horse-drawn carriage (brougham) WITHOUT the horse: a lofted coach body with a curved underside, roll… joints brake, spin_rear_l, spin_rear_r, front_axle, spin_front_l, spin_front_r, …; options cover, box_paint, gear_paint, cover_colour; sockets socket_hitch, socket_traces, seat_driver, seat_pax_1, eye_point, socket_cargo, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.horse_carriage or place "prefab": "horse_carriage" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
